title: DimensionAssessment
description: AI-produced, advisory assessment of one role-scoped compatibility dimension. There are no bare scores: every scored dimension carries confidence, the admitted evidence it consumed (by lineage node), an assessment version, and rationale/provenance. The Decision Authority reasons over (evidence, confidence), not score alone. This schema tracks the implemented domain model ugence_ai_hiring.hiring_decision.assessment.DimensionAssessment.

dimension.description: Role-scoped dimension id, e.g. TECHNICAL, OPERATING_ENVIRONMENT_COMPATIBILITY. CULTURE_FIT and RESILIENCE are forbidden.

outcome.description: SCORED when required evidence admitted AND confidence >= floor; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

score.description: Present only when outcome==SCORED. Null when INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

confidence.description: How much the assessor trusts this dimension's score. Low confidence is a request for more evidence, never a reason to lower the score.

evidence_refs.description: Admitted Evidence Lineage node ids this assessment consumed. A SCORED assessment must cite at least one.

assessment_version.description: Version of this candidate/dimension assessment; a re-assessment increments it.

gaps.description: What evidence, if admitted, would raise confidence or resolve INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

provenance.description: Where the assessment came from (engine/model identity + time).

pre_hire_justified.description: ROLE_SUSTAINABILITY_AND_ADAPTATION is post-hire-oriented; it may be SCORED pre-hire only when this is true, backed by job-relevant evidence.

advisory_only.description: Hard invariant: a dimension assessment is advisory and can never be a decision.
